section.div: Health management platform linking village sub-centres to the state health department. 15+ roles, offline sync, Zia AI escalation. Live on Zoho Catalyst.
TruthGuard: AI fake-news detection with NLP credibility scoring and TruthBot, a Gemini-powered chatbot (Infosys Springboard internship).
AI task optimizer that reads emotion from text, face and speech, recommends tasks and flags burnout to HR (Amdox internship).
End-to-end ML pipelines: TF-IDF + Naive Bayes spam detector served via FastAPI, and a house price regression model (QSkill internship).
